title: cynodon dactylon subsp. glabratus
intro: Cynodon dactylon subsp. glabratus, commonly known as Smooth Bristle Grass, is a subspecies of the Cynodon dactylon species, a type of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Bristle Grass include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which may contribute to its ability to heal wounds and treat infections. The bioactive constituents of Smooth Bristle Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
